For each of J's 14 rooms, how the global model is instantiated in it, as in the form telling, with one figure each drawn as in round 2; then a short note across the 14. The forms are as J lists them (room-forms-tree-rooms.tsv). Two are already told in round 2 and are pointed to: r/norway (room-A-norway.md) and r/PlaceNL (room-B-PlaceNL.md). Twelve are new: cirkeltrek, indonesia, placehearts, mindcrack, Goodboye (A); norge, czech, armenia, sweden (B); blackmirror (C); greece (D); thenetherlands (E). Four are thin rooms (cirkeltrek 3 selected changes, norge 1, sweden 4, blackmirror 4), so 14 is not too many for one leg. The round-1 facts script read only defining rooms' lines; I widen it to thin rooms' lines too (defining rooms' facts unchanged, checked by re-generating a figure). Thin rooms' restrict lines were not in the D5 sort (it read defining members only), so their figures draw such lines as 'restrict, not sorted'.
